disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Выбранный вариант отчёта
description: OPTION A: Basic либо OPTION B: Basic + Comprehensive
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. Select OPTION A (Basic Module only) or OPTION B (Basic and Comprehensive Modules) and store the choice for the reporting period.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Пропущенное чувствительное раскрытие
title_en: Disclosure omitted as classified or sensitive information
description: Код/название раскрытия, исключённого как classified or sensitive
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. Identify each omitted disclosure and document that the omission is due to classified or sensitive information.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: База подготовки отчёта
title_en: Individual or consolidated basis of preparation
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. State whether the report covers only the undertaking or the undertaking and its subsidiaries, and apply the same basis throughout the report.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Перечень дочерних организаций
title_en: Subsidiaries covered by the consolidated report
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. For a consolidated report, list every included subsidiary and its registered address and link it to the reporting boundary.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Юридический адрес дочерней организации
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. For a consolidated report, list every included subsidiary and its registered address and link it to the reporting boundary.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Организационно-правовая форма
guidance: Guidance para. 68: select the legal form recognised under the national legislation of the undertaking's country.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Код NACE
description: Один или несколько кодов секторной классификации NACE
guidance: Guidance paras. 69–70: select the NACE code that best represents the undertaking's main activity; use the most detailed available level and allow additional codes where relevant.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Размер баланса
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. Use the value for the same reporting period as the sustainability report, state the currency and reconcile it with the financial statements.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Оборот
guidance: No separate completion instruction is provided in Basic Module Guidance for this datapoint. Use the value for the same reporting period as the sustainability report, state the currency and reconcile it with the financial statements.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Количество сотрудников
title_en: Number of employees in headcount or full-time equivalents
description: Headcount либо FTE с указанием метода
guidance: Guidance paras. 71–72: state whether the figure is headcount or FTE. Calculate FTE from contracted working time and record the reference date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Страна основных операций
guidance: Guidance para. 73: report the information for each significant site, including address, postal code, city, country and coordinates.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Местонахождение значимых активов
guidance: Guidance para. 73: report the information for each significant site, including address, postal code, city, country and coordinates.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Геолокация площадок
title_en: Geolocation of sites owned, leased or managed
description: Координаты owned, leased or managed sites
guidance: Guidance paras. 74–76: store geolocation as a spatial point for a single site or polygon coordinates for an area; cover every owned, leased or managed site.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Сертификация или label
guidance: Guidance para. 77: record the certification or label name, issuing body, date and, where relevant, rating or score; retain supporting evidence.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Орган, выдавший сертификат
guidance: Guidance para. 77: record the certification or label name, issuing body, date and, where relevant, rating or score; retain supporting evidence.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Дата сертификата
guidance: Guidance para. 77: record the certification or label name, issuing body, date and, where relevant, rating or score; retain supporting evidence.

disclosure_title: Основа подготовки отчёта / Basis for preparation
title: Рейтинг/оценка сертификата
guidance: Guidance para. 77: record the certification or label name, issuing body, date and, where relevant, rating or score; retain supporting evidence.

disclosure_title: Практики, политики и будущие инициативы перехода к устойчивой экономике / Practices, policies and future initiatives
title: Практики устойчивого развития
guidance: Guidance paras. 78–80: use a structured record for sustainability practices, identify the sustainability issue addressed, describe the action or commitment, and record any target, responsible person, timeframe and public URL.

disclosure_title: Практики, политики и будущие инициативы перехода к устойчивой экономике / Practices, policies and future initiatives
title: Политики устойчивого развития
guidance: Guidance paras. 78–80: use a structured record for sustainability policies, identify the sustainability issue addressed, describe the action or commitment, and record any target, responsible person, timeframe and public URL.

disclosure_title: Практики, политики и будущие инициативы перехода к устойчивой экономике / Practices, policies and future initiatives
title: Публичность политик
guidance: Guidance paras. 78–80: use a structured record for public availability of sustainability policies, identify the sustainability issue addressed, describe the action or commitment, and record any target, responsible person, timeframe and public URL.

disclosure_title: Практики, политики и будущие инициативы перехода к устойчивой экономике / Practices, policies and future initiatives
title: Будущие инициативы
title_en: Future sustainability initiatives or forward-looking plans
description: Планы и инициативы в процессе реализации
guidance: Guidance paras. 78–80: use a structured record for future sustainability initiatives or forward-looking plans, identify the sustainability issue addressed, describe the action or commitment, and record any target, responsible person, timeframe and public URL.

disclosure_title: Практики, политики и будущие инициативы перехода к устойчивой экономике / Practices, policies and future initiatives
title: Цели
title_en: Targets to monitor implementation and progress
description: Цели для мониторинга реализации политик и прогресса
guidance: Guidance paras. 78–80: use a structured record for targets to monitor implementation and progress, identify the sustainability issue addressed, describe the action or commitment, and record any target, responsible person, timeframe and public URL.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Электроэнергия возобновляемая
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report renewable electricity consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Электроэнергия невозобновляемая
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report non-renewable electricity consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Топливо возобновляемое
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report renewable fuel consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Топливо невозобновляемое
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report non-renewable fuel consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Итого возобновляемая энергия
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report total renewable energy consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Итого невозобновляемая энергия
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report total non-renewable energy consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Общее потребление энергии
guidance: Guidance paras. 81–89: report total energy consumption as final energy in MWh. Preserve the original quantity and unit, convert using a documented calorific value or conversion factor, and do not net energy consumed against energy produced.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Gross Scope 1 GHG emissions
guidance: Guidance paras. 90–108: define the organisational boundary, include all owned or controlled direct emission sources, calculate CO2, CH4, N2O and relevant gases in tCO2e, and retain activity data, factor source, GWP basis and calculation version.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: Scope 2 location-based
description: Выбросы purchased electricity, heat, steam, cooling
guidance: Guidance paras. 90–109: calculate purchased electricity, heat, steam and cooling using the location-based method; retain consumption, geography, reporting year and grid factor. Market-based Scope 2 may be shown separately where reliable contractual information exists.

disclosure_title: Энергия и выбросы парниковых газов / Energy and greenhouse gas emissions
title: GHG intensity
description: Gross Scope 1 + Scope 2 LB, делённые на turnover EUR
guidance: Guidance paras. 90–103: divide gross Scope 1 plus location-based Scope 2 emissions by turnover in euro for the same reporting period; do not subtract offsets or removals.

disclosure_title: Загрязнение воздуха, воды и почвы / Pollution of air, water and soil
disclosure_title_en: Pollution of air, water and soil
title: Выбросы загрязнителей Воздух
description: Наименование и количество каждого загрязнителя: воздух
applicability_condition: Если уже требуется законом/нац. нормами или добровольно по EMS
guidance: Guidance paras. 110–133: first confirm that pollution reporting is legally required or performed under an environmental management system. For pollutants emitted to air, record each pollutant separately with medium, quantity, unit, facility, method and reporting period; a public source may be cross-referenced.

disclosure_title: Загрязнение воздуха, воды и почвы / Pollution of air, water and soil
disclosure_title_en: Pollution of air, water and soil
title: Выбросы загрязнителей Вода
description: Наименование и количество каждого загрязнителя: вода
applicability_condition: Если уже требуется законом/нац. нормами или добровольно по EMS
guidance: Guidance paras. 110–133: first confirm that pollution reporting is legally required or performed under an environmental management system. For pollutants emitted to water, record each pollutant separately with medium, quantity, unit, facility, method and reporting period; a public source may be cross-referenced.

disclosure_title: Загрязнение воздуха, воды и почвы / Pollution of air, water and soil
disclosure_title_en: Pollution of air, water and soil
title: Выбросы загрязнителей Почва
description: Наименование и количество каждого загрязнителя: почва
applicability_condition: Если уже требуется законом/нац. нормами или добровольно по EMS
guidance: Guidance paras. 110–133: first confirm that pollution reporting is legally required or performed under an environmental management system. For pollutants emitted to soil, record each pollutant separately with medium, quantity, unit, facility, method and reporting period; a public source may be cross-referenced.

disclosure_title: Загрязнение воздуха, воды и почвы / Pollution of air, water and soil
disclosure_title_en: Pollution of air, water and soil
title: Публичная ссылка на сведения о загрязнении
title_en: Public link to reported pollutant information
applicability_condition: Если используется ссылка вместо повторного раскрытия
guidance: Guidance paras. 110–133: first confirm that pollution reporting is legally required or performed under an environmental management system. For public link to reported pollutant information, record each pollutant separately with medium, quantity, unit, facility, method and reporting period; a public source may be cross-referenced.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Количество площадок в/рядом с biodiversity-sensitive area
title_en: Number of sites in or near biodiversity-sensitive areas
guidance: Guidance paras. 134–137: screen every owned, leased or managed site against recognised biodiversity-sensitive areas; report the site count and area in hectares and retain the geospatial evidence.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Площадь площадок в/рядом с biodiversity-sensitive area
title_en: Area of sites in or near biodiversity-sensitive areas
guidance: Guidance paras. 134–137: screen every owned, leased or managed site against recognised biodiversity-sensitive areas; report the site count and area in hectares and retain the geospatial evidence.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Общее землепользование
guidance: Guidance paras. 138–141: calculate total use of land in hectares using consistent site boundaries and land-use definitions; distinguish sealed and nature-oriented areas and document the mapping method.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Запечатанная площадь
guidance: Guidance paras. 138–141: calculate total sealed area in hectares using consistent site boundaries and land-use definitions; distinguish sealed and nature-oriented areas and document the mapping method.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Nature-oriented area on-site
guidance: Guidance paras. 138–141: calculate nature-oriented area on-site in hectares using consistent site boundaries and land-use definitions; distinguish sealed and nature-oriented areas and document the mapping method.

disclosure_title: Биоразнообразие / Biodiversity
title: Nature-oriented area off-site
guidance: Guidance paras. 138–141: calculate nature-oriented area off-site in hectares using consistent site boundaries and land-use definitions; distinguish sealed and nature-oriented areas and document the mapping method.

disclosure_title: Вода / Water
title: Общий водозабор
guidance: Guidance paras. 142–149 and 154–158: obtain water withdrawal from meters or bills where possible; for shared premises use a documented allocation method based on area, employees or another representative driver, and report in m³.

disclosure_title: Вода / Water
title: Водозабор в зонах высокого водного стресса
title_en: Water withdrawal at sites in areas of high water stress
applicability_condition: Если есть площадки в high water-stress areas
guidance: Guidance paras. 142–158: determine water-stress status for each site using a recognised local authority or water-risk tool, then report withdrawal for high-water-stress sites separately in m³.

disclosure_title: Вода / Water
title: Водопотребление
description: Withdrawal minus discharge from production processes
guidance: Guidance paras. 150–155: calculate water consumption as water withdrawal minus water discharge for significant production processes; report in m³ and retain meter, bill or estimation evidence.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Применение принципов circular economy
guidance: Guidance para. 159: briefly explain how circular-economy principles are applied to products, materials and waste, including prevention, reuse, repair, recycling or other relevant practices.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Общий объём отходов
guidance: Guidance paras. 160–172: report total annual generation of waste by waste type and treatment route in tonnes. Distinguish hazardous and non-hazardous waste, use the European Waste Catalogue where possible, and reconcile totals with waste-transfer records.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Неопасные отходы
guidance: Guidance paras. 160–172: report non-hazardous waste generated by waste type and treatment route in tonnes. Distinguish hazardous and non-hazardous waste, use the European Waste Catalogue where possible, and reconcile totals with waste-transfer records.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Опасные отходы
guidance: Guidance paras. 160–172: report hazardous waste generated by waste type and treatment route in tonnes. Distinguish hazardous and non-hazardous waste, use the European Waste Catalogue where possible, and reconcile totals with waste-transfer records.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Отходы, направленные на recycling/reuse
title_en: Waste diverted to recycling or reuse
guidance: Guidance paras. 160–172: report waste diverted to recycling or reuse by waste type and treatment route in tonnes. Distinguish hazardous and non-hazardous waste, use the European Waste Catalogue where possible, and reconcile totals with waste-transfer records.

disclosure_title: Использование ресурсов, циркулярная экономика и отходы / Resource use, circular economy and waste
disclosure_title_en: Resource use, circular economy and waste
title: Массовый поток используемых материалов
title_en: Annual mass-flow of relevant materials used
applicability_condition: Для секторов со значительными материальными потоками
guidance: Guidance paras. 173–174: report the annual mass of relevant materials used by undertakings with significant material flows; define the included processes and material categories and use a consistent mass unit.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники постоянный договор
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees with permanent employment contracts using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники временный договор
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees with temporary employment contracts using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники женщины
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees by gender- female using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники мужчины
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees by gender- male using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники иной/не указан пол
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees by gender- other/not reported using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Сотрудники по стране договора
title_en: Employees by country of employment contract
applicability_condition: Если компания работает более чем в одной стране
guidance: Guidance paras. 175–181: report employees by country of employment contract using one consistent basis—headcount or FTE—and reconcile the breakdown with the total workforce. Use national contract definitions and store the reporting date or averaging period.

disclosure_title: Общие характеристики персонала / Workforce general characteristics
title: Коэффициент текучести
guidance: Guidance paras. 182–183: calculate the turnover rate as employees who left during the reporting period divided by the average number of employees, multiplied by 100; retain both numerator and denominator.

disclosure_title: Охрана труда и безопасность / Workforce health and safety
title: Количество регистрируемых несчастных случаев
guidance: Guidance paras. 187–191: report number of recordable work-related accidents for employees, applying the work-related definitions consistently to on-site work, telework and business travel; retain incident classification and evidence.

disclosure_title: Охрана труда и безопасность / Workforce health and safety
title: Коэффициент несчастных случаев
guidance: Guidance paras. 184–186: calculate the rate as recordable work-related accidents divided by total hours worked, multiplied by 200,000; retain accident records and hours worked.

disclosure_title: Охрана труда и безопасность / Workforce health and safety
title: Смертельные случаи вследствие травм
title_en: Fatalities as a result of work-related injuries
guidance: Guidance paras. 187–191: report fatalities as a result of work-related injuries for employees, applying the work-related definitions consistently to on-site work, telework and business travel; retain incident classification and evidence.

disclosure_title: Охрана труда и безопасность / Workforce health and safety
title: Смертельные случаи вследствие профзаболеваний
title_en: Fatalities as a result of work-related ill health
guidance: Guidance paras. 187–191: report fatalities as a result of work-related ill health for employees, applying the work-related definitions consistently to on-site work, telework and business travel; retain incident classification and evidence.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Соответствие минимальной оплате труда
title_en: Employees paid at or above the applicable minimum wage
description: Все сотрудники получают не ниже applicable minimum wage
guidance: Guidance paras. 192–193: compare the lowest applicable employee pay with the statutory or collectively agreed minimum wage in each reporting country; exclude interns and apprentices where appropriate.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Гендерный разрыв в оплате
applicability_condition: Можно опустить при <150 HC; порог 100 с 07.06.2031
guidance: Guidance paras. 194–201: include all employees, calculate average gross hourly pay by gender and apply the VSME percentage-gap formula; document included pay elements and working-hour conversion.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Охват коллективными договорами
title_en: Employees covered by collective bargaining agreements
guidance: Guidance paras. 202–205: divide employees covered by collective bargaining agreements by total employees and multiply by 100; apply the agreement to all covered employees, whether union members or not.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Средние часы обучения женщины
title_en: Average annual training hours per employee- female
description: Average annual training hours per employee by gender
guidance: Guidance paras. 192–205: calculate average annual training hours per employee- female from payroll or HR records for the reporting period, use consistent employee and gender definitions, and retain the numerator, denominator and calculation basis.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Средние часы обучения мужчины
title_en: Average annual training hours per employee- male
description: Average annual training hours per employee by gender
guidance: Guidance paras. 192–205: calculate average annual training hours per employee- male from payroll or HR records for the reporting period, use consistent employee and gender definitions, and retain the numerator, denominator and calculation basis.

disclosure_title: Оплата труда, коллективные договоры и обучение / Remuneration, collective bargaining and training
title: Средние часы обучения иной/не указан пол
title_en: Average annual training hours per employee- other/not reported
description: Average annual training hours per employee by gender
guidance: Guidance paras. 192–205: calculate average annual training hours per employee- other/not reported from payroll or HR records for the reporting period, use consistent employee and gender definitions, and retain the numerator, denominator and calculation basis.

disclosure_title: Приговоры и штрафы за коррупцию и взяточничество / Convictions and fines for corruption and bribery
disclosure_title_en: Convictions and fines for corruption and bribery
title: Количество обвинительных приговоров
title_en: Number of convictions for violations of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws
guidance: Guidance paras. 206–209: report number of convictions for violations of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws for final convictions or mandatory monetary penalties under anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws during the reporting period; retain legal references and evidence.

disclosure_title: Приговоры и штрафы за коррупцию и взяточничество / Convictions and fines for corruption and bribery
disclosure_title_en: Convictions and fines for corruption and bribery
title: Сумма штрафов
title_en: Total amount of fines for violations of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws
guidance: Guidance paras. 206–209: report total amount of fines for violations of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws for final convictions or mandatory monetary penalties under anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws during the reporting period; retain legal references and evidence.

disclosure_title: Стратегия, бизнес-модель и инициативы устойчивого развития / Strategy, business model and sustainability-related initiatives
disclosure_title_en: Strategy, business model and sustainability-related initiatives
title: Значимые группы продуктов/услуг
title_en: Significant groups of products and/or services offered
guidance: No separate detailed completion instruction is provided in Comprehensive Guidance para. 212 for this datapoint. Describe significant groups of products and/or services offered concisely, using the same scope and terminology as the undertaking's business model and strategy.
